<?php
/**
 * ML Inference Server with Encrypted Model Storage
 * Handles secure model loading and prediction serving
 */

class CertificateValidator {
    private $trustedCAs;
    private $crlEndpoint;
    private $validationDepth;
    
    public function __construct(array $config) {
        $this->trustedCAs = $config['ca_bundle'] ?? '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt';
        $this->crlEndpoint = $config['crl_endpoint'] ?? null;
        $this->validationDepth = $config['max_depth'] ?? 4;
    }
    
    public function validatePeerCertificate(string $certPem, string $expectedCN): bool {
        $cert = openssl_x509_parse($certPem);
        if (!$cert) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check expiration
        $now = time();
        if ($now < $cert['validFrom_time_t'] || $now > $cert['validTo_time_t']) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Verify the certificate chain
        if (!$this->verifyChain($certPem)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate Common Name or Subject Alternative Names
        return $this->matchesHostname($cert, $expectedCN);
    }
    
    private function verifyChain(string $certPem): bool {
        $tempCert = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'cert_');
        file_put_contents($tempCert, $certPem);
        
        $cmd = sprintf(
            'openssl verify -CAfile %s -partial_chain %s 2>&1',
            escapeshellarg($this->trustedCAs),
            escapeshellarg($tempCert)
        );
        
        $output = shell_exec($cmd);
        unlink($tempCert);
        
        return strpos($output, ': OK') !== false;
    }
    
    private function matchesHostname(array $cert, string $hostname): bool {
        // Check Subject CN
        $cn = $cert['subject']['CN'] ?? '';
        if ($this->wildcardMatch($cn, $hostname)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check SANs
        $sans = $cert['extensions']['subjectAltName'] ?? '';
        foreach (explode(',', $sans) as $san) {
            $san = trim($san);
            if (strpos($san, 'DNS:') === 0) {
                $dnsName = substr($san, 4);
                if ($this->wildcardMatch($dnsName, $hostname)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private function wildcardMatch(string $pattern, string $hostname): bool {
        if ($pattern === $hostname) {
            return true;
        }
        // Support wildcard certificates
        if (strpos($pattern, '*') === 0) {
            $suffix = substr($pattern, 1);
            return substr($hostname, -strlen($suffix)) === $suffix;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class EncryptedModelStore {
    private $storagePath;
    private $encryptionKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $path, string $key) {
        $this->storagePath = realpath($path) ?: $path;
        $this->encryptionKey = $key;
    }
    
    public function loadModel(string $modelId): ?array {
        $filePath = $this->storagePath . '/' . basename($modelId) . '.enc';
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $encrypted = file_get_contents($filePath);
        $iv = substr($encrypted, 0, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($encrypted, 16, -32);
        $storedHmac = substr($encrypted, -32);
        
        // Verify integrity
        $computedHmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $iv . $ciphertext, $this->encryptionKey, true);
        if (!hash_equals($storedHmac, $computedHmac)) {
            error_log("Model integrity check failed for: $modelId");
            return null;
        }
        
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-cbc', $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv);
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return json_decode($decrypted, true);
    }
}

class InferenceServer {
    private $validator;
    private $modelStore;
    private $allowedOrigins;
    
    public function __construct(CertificateValidator $validator, EncryptedModelStore $store) {
        $this->validator = $validator;
        $this->modelStore = $store;
        $this->allowedOrigins = ['inference.internal.corp', 'ml-gateway.internal.corp'];
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        // Mutual TLS - validate client certificate
        $clientCert = $request['client_cert'] ?? null;
        if (!$clientCert) {
            return ['error' => 'Client certificate required', 'code' => 401];
        }
        
        // Validate against any allowed origin
        $authenticated = false;
        foreach ($this->allowedOrigins as $origin) {
            if ($this->validator->validatePeerCertificate($clientCert, $origin)) {
                $authenticated = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (!$authenticated) {
            return ['error' => 'Certificate validation failed', 'code' => 403];
        }
        
        // Process inference request
        $modelId = $request['model_id'] ?? null;
        $inputData = $request['input'] ?? null;
        
        if (!$modelId || !$inputData) {
            return ['error' => 'Missing model_id or input', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        $model = $this->modelStore->loadModel($modelId);
        if (!$model) {
            return ['error' => 'Model not found or corrupted', 'code' => 404];
        }
        
        return $this->runInference($model, $inputData);
    }
    
    private function runInference(array $model, array $input): array {
        // Simple linear model inference: y = Wx + b
        $weights = $model['weights'] ?? [];
        $biases = $model['biases'] ?? [];
        
        $output = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($biases); $i++) {
            $sum = $biases[$i];
            for ($j = 0; $j < count($input); $j++) {
                $sum += ($weights[$i][$j] ?? 0) * $input[$j];
            }
            $output[] = $this->sigmoid($sum);
        }
        
        return ['predictions' => $output, 'code' => 200];
    }
    
    private function sigmoid(float $x): float {
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-$x));
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$config = [
    'ca_bundle' => getenv('CA_BUNDLE_PATH') ?: '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt',
    'crl_endpoint' => getenv('CRL_ENDPOINT') ?: null,
    'max_depth' => 4
];

$validator = new CertificateValidator($config);
$store = new EncryptedModelStore(
    getenv('MODEL_STORE_PATH') ?: '/var/lib/ml-models',
    getenv('MODEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY') ?: ''
);

$server = new InferenceServer($validator, $store);

// Read request from stdin (for testing) or HTTP context
$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
$request = json_decode($rawInput, true) ?? [];
$request['client_cert'] = $_SERVER['SSL_CLIENT_CERT'] ?? ($request['client_cert'] ?? null);

$response = $server->handleRequest($request);
http_response_code($response['code']);
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($response);
